title: Models in the wild
subtitle: Rethinking modelling in the context of climate change
author: Dan Olner
description: How can quantitative modelling live in the world? A 2013 talk comparing orthodox modelling, agent-based 'virtual worlds' and social technology, with climate change and transport as the backdrop.
